fill_adjustment.note: Fill-adjusted values use the current proxy queue/fill model and remain non-capital evidence until authenticated fills validate it.

limitations: Historical replay uses recorded CLOB quotes; it is still not authenticated fill proof.
Buy markers are simulated maker entries at historical entry_bid; sell markers are marked at future_bid for the trained horizon.
Fill-adjusted PnL multiplies maker PnL by proxy fill probability; it is not a substitute for authenticated order lifecycle evidence.
Queue position and actual order acceptance remain live-only evidence requirements.
